extension: oblique incident-wave heading (exact reference from axial symmetry)

gates.criterion: max over ka, heading of |V(beta) - R_beta V(0)| / |V(0)| < 0.05 on the 1024-panel case mesh
|Mz| / (rho g A a^3) < 0.001 for every cell (exactly zero by axial symmetry)
|V_direct(beta) - R_beta V_rotated(0)| / |V| < 0.001 (the two discrete problems are the same problem in rotated coordinates)
|V_solve - V_Haskind| / |V_solve| < 0.05 on the three force components, for the Kochin and for the boundary Haskind integral
|A22/A11 - 1| < 0.05, |B22/B11 - 1| < 0.05 (exact by axial symmetry) and |A12|, |B12| dimensionless cross terms < 5e-2
|nabla_mesh/nabla - 1| < 2% and |A_wp/(pi a^2) - 1| < 2% on the primary (case) mesh, as in the anchor's own G2

coarse_geometry_note: the refinement-control rung (256 panels) has a mesh-volume error above the 2% geometry precondition; that is a property of the coarse rung, documented by the anchor case, and is why the graded mesh is the 1024-panel one
